recent_articles.title: How Pakistan's Social Media Star Shahzad Bhatti Became ISI's New Weapon
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Shahzad Bhatti**, a Pakistani social media influencer linked to the **ISI**, is at the center of a major crackdown by Indian security agencies.  Bhatti's network, which recruits vulnerable youth through social media, allegedly involves criminal activity, radicalization, and plans for attacks on police personnel and sensitive locations. The Delhi Police Special Cell arrested eight suspects connected to Bhatti's module, recovering weapons and explosives. Investigations also reveal links to the **Tehreek-e-Taliban Hindustan** and a network of violent crimes in Punjab, including the grenade attack on a YouTuber.  Bhatti faces multiple investigations and threats from rival gangs like the Lawrence Bishnoi gang, highlighting his complex role in India's security landscape.

recent_articles.title: First-Ever Standalone Policy For Single Women To Be Introduced In This State | OdishaBytes
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Mahayuti** government in Maharashtra has approved the formation of a draft committee to develop a "Single Women Policy." The policy, spearheaded by **Women and Child Development minister Aditi Tatkare**, aims to empower single women across the state through access to government welfare schemes and addressing their unique concerns.  The policy will benefit widows, divorced, deserted, and unmarried women who often face social and economic challenges due to a lack of support systems. The committee will be chaired by the Commissioner of the Women and Child Development Commissionerate, Pune, and include representatives from various state departments.

recent_articles.title: Lok Sabha election 2024: Maharashtra get interesting after splits in Shiv Sena, NCP - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The upcoming Lok Sabha elections in Maharashtra will be influenced by splits within the Shiv Sena and NCP, along with traditional issues like unemployment and farmer suicides. The BJP-Shiv Sena alliance won 41 of the 48 seats in 2019, but the split has shifted the political landscape.  **Eknath Shinde** leads the ruling alliance in Maharashtra, while Ajit Pawar joined the alliance after splitting from the NCP. **Manoj Jarange**, a Maratha quota activist, is gaining traction in Marathwada. The region will be crucial to watch as it has traditionally been a stronghold for the BJP-Shiv Sena.  The elections are scheduled across five phases between April 19 and May 20 with counting on June 4. Over 9.2 crore citizens are eligible to vote, an increase of 34 lakh from 2019.

recent_articles.title: Spurious liquor kills 15 in Pune, Pimpri-Chinchwad; 8 held, probe ordered - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: At least 15 people have died in Pune and Pimpri-Chinchwad after consuming spurious liquor, prompting an investigation by **Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis** and the **Excise Department**.  **Yogesh Wankhede**, who brought ethanol without permission, is suspected of preparing the illicit alcohol at a location in Hadapsar before supplying it to vendors. The deaths occurred over three days, with residents expressing anger towards authorities for allegedly failing to prevent the sale of illegal liquor.  The investigation is ongoing and more arrests are expected.

recent_articles.title: Tell your ‘petty politicians’ not to blame the court for delay, CJI tells Thackeray-Shinde factions - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Supreme Court** expressed frustration with the "petty politicians" of the Uddhav Thackeray and Eknath Shinde factions of the Shiv Sena for making accusations against the court regarding delays in their dispute over the party symbol.  Chief Justice of India Surya Kant criticized the parties' media statements, urging them to refrain from such actions. Senior advocate Mukul Rohatgi, representing the Shinde faction, acknowledged that irresponsible comments were made and urged the court to set a specific date for final arguments. The case, which has been pending for years, centers on the Election Commission's February 2023 order assigning the symbol 'bow and arrow' to the Shinde faction, challenging the Thackeray faction's claim to the party name and symbol.

recent_articles.title: CM Fadnavis’ bike ride draws Opposition ire - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Devendra Fadnavis**, the **Maharashtra** Chief Minister, rode a motorbike to Vidhan Bhavan after Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** called for austerity measures. The move drew criticism from the Opposition who urged Ministers to use public transport instead.  **Sharad Pawar**, NCP SP president, questioned the timing of the austerity measures and demanded an all-party meeting with the Prime Minister. He also criticized the State Government ministers' language towards **Rahul Gandhi**, the Leader of Opposition in Parliament.

recent_articles.title: Ten new MLCs sworn in at Maharashtra Vidhan Bhavan - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ten newly elected members of the Maharashtra Legislative Council (MLC)** took their oaths on Thursday, May 14, 2026, following the end of nine sitting MLCs' terms. The new members include representatives from the **BJP**, **Shiv Sena**, and **NCP**.  The ceremony was presided over by **Legislative Council chairperson Ram Shinde** and attended by key figures like **Assembly Speaker Rahul Narwekar**, **Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis**, and **Deputy Chief Ministers Eknath Shinde and Sunetra Ajit**. The Upper House currently has 22 vacancies, with the majority of seats held by the **BJP** due to their dominance in the Legislative Assembly.

recent_articles.title: NEET-UG examination 2026: One suspect arrested from Nashik - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The National Testing Agency (NTA)** cancelled the NEET-UG examination for 2026 after an alleged paper leak, leading to the arrest of a suspect in **Maharashtra**. The Rajasthan Police requested the **Maharashtra police** to detain the individual who was apprehended after changing his appearance.  The cancellation has drawn criticism from opposition leaders, including **Rohit Pawar**, who pointed out that the state government's new law against paper leaks is insufficient and called for stricter action against those involved. A CBI inquiry into the matter has been initiated.

recent_articles.title: Rupali Chakankar appears before SIT in 'godman' Kharat case - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rupali Chakankar**, NCP leader and former State women’s panel chief, appeared before the special investigation team (SIT) in Nashik to answer questions about her alleged association with self-styled godman **Ashok Kharat**.  Ms. Chakankar resigned from both positions following revelations of her ties to **Kharat**, who is currently under arrest for rape and sexual exploitation. The Maharashtra Government has set up an SIT to investigate 12 cases against **Kharat** in Nashik and Ahilyanagar districts, with the SIT likely to question Ms. Chakankar about her connection to him.  Senior Congress leader **Nana Patole** alleged that **Kharat**’s life is in danger in prison and demanded the removal of four ministers connected to him from the state cabinet.

recent_articles.title: NCP(SP) leader splashed with ink by right-wing preacher - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Vikas Lawande**, spokesperson for the **NCP(SP)**, was allegedly attacked with black ink in Pune, Maharashtra on Saturday by a group led by right-wing preacher **Sangram Bhandare**. The attack followed **Lawande's** remarks about **Bhandare's** gurus, who are part of the Warkari movement.  **Lawande** reported the incident to the police and demanded action against the attackers. Several political leaders, including **Shashikant Shinde**, **Mehbub Shaikh**, and **Vijay Wadettiwar**, condemned the attack and called for protection of free speech.

recent_articles.title: Kerala Assembly polls 2026: LDF, UDF keeping their fingers crossed in Kozhikode - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Political fronts** in **Kozhikode** are closely watching the election results on May 4th, as the district's outcome could significantly impact government formation in the state.  Key contests include Perambra, Beypore, Elathur, and Vadakara, where candidates from the **Left Democratic Front (LDF)** face off against those from the **United Democratic Front (UDF)**. While the LDF has historically dominated the district, recent exit polls predict a less favorable outcome for the ruling front, with some internal discussions suggesting potential losses in key constituencies.

recent_articles.title: Amid traffic woes on Mumbai-Pune highway, Maharashtra govt. inaugurates ‘Missing Link’ project - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The Maharashtra government inaugurated the "Missing Link" project of the Mumbai-Pune Expressway on May 1, 2026, aiming to reduce travel time and bypass a risky ghat section near Lonavala. **CM Devendra Fadnavis** apologized for traffic congestion caused by the launch coinciding with a long weekend and heavy traffic due to car breakdowns. The project, completed at a cost of ₹7,181 crore, features Asia's widest underground tunnel and will reduce travel time between Mumbai and Pune by 30 minutes. **Supriya Sule**, an NCP(SP) leader, was among those stuck in the traffic jam.  The project is expected to boost the state's economy by ₹70,000 crore.

recent_articles.title: Maharashtra Legislative Council elections to be unopposed as Congress backtracks, Shinde fields two candidates - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** has withdrawn its decision to field a candidate for the nine Legislative Council seats in Maharashtra, supporting **Ambadas Danve** from **Shiv Sena UBT** after marathon meetings and phone calls between top leaders.  The decision was announced by **Maharashtra Congress president Harshawardhan Sapkal**, who also spoke alongside leaders of the Maha Vikas Aghadi. After a day of speculation, nine candidates filed their nominations for the seats, with each party securing its allotted quota.

recent_articles.title: Analysis: Why there is a ‘Pawar play’ over political legacy in Baramati - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sharad Pawar**'s legacy in **Baramati**, Maharashtra, is being challenged after the death of his nephew, **Ajit Pawar**.  The constituency, long dominated by the **Pawar** family, faces uncertainty as younger generations seek their own political paths. The BJP seeks to capitalize on this shift while the NCP and its allied party, **NCP (SP)**, grapple with internal divisions.

recent_articles.title: Veteran NCP leader T.P. Peethambharan turns 99 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **T.P. Peethambharan**, a veteran politician and NCP national general secretary, celebrated his 99th birthday on Thursday (April 23, 2026).  He received greetings from various dignitaries including **Minister P. Rajeeve**, **CPI(M) leader K.N. Unnikrishnan**, and **Congress leader V.M. Sudheeran**. Peethambharan's political career began with the youth wing of the Congress and spanned eight decades, during which he served in the Kerala Legislative Assembly three times and also taught at SDPY school.

recent_articles.title: BJP to contest four seats in upcoming Maharashtra Legislative Council polls - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **BJP** will contest four of the nine seats in the upcoming Maharashtra Legislative Council biennial elections, scheduled for May 12. The party's strategy was discussed at a meeting led by Chief Minister **Devendra Fadnavis**.  Candidates for the by-election for the seat vacated by Pradnya Satav are being shortlisted and will be sent to the central leadership for approval.  The Election Commission of India has set a quota of 29 votes for each council seat, with the by-election requiring 144 votes.

recent_articles.title: Baramati, Rahuri all set to conduct byelections on April 23 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Maharashtra** is holding by-elections in two constituencies, Baramati and Rahuri, on April 23, 2026.  The **Congress** withdrew its candidate from Baramati, paving the way for Deputy Chief Minister Sunetra Pawar to contest. The Baramati by-election is significant as it marks the first election since the death of the former MLA, Ajit Pawar. In Rahuri, the BJP's Akshay Kardile faces off against NCP-SP candidate Govind Mokate from the **Maha Vikas Aghadi**.

recent_articles.title: Bombay High Court quashes arrest of Sheetal Tejwani in two cases, upholds third - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sheetal Tejwani**, a businessperson, was found by the **Bombay High Court** to have been illegally arrested in two cases by the **Pimpri and Bavdhan police stations**. The court upheld her arrest in a third case at the **Khadak police station**.  The court ruled that the grounds of arrest were not communicated to Tejwani during her arrests, violating her constitutional rights.

recent_articles.title: Mahayuti to launch signature campaign in Maharashtra on Women’s Reservation Bill - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The ruling Mahayuti** party in Maharashtra is launching a signature campaign from April 21 to collect one crore signatures of women, protesting the recent defeat of the Women’s Reservation Bill and Delimitation Bill. **Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis** challenged the opposition parties for an open debate on the issue, accusing them of stalling increased women's reservation and SC/ST reservations.  **Supriya Sule**, an NCP SP MP, and **Praniti Shinde**, a Congress MP, accepted the challenge, while **Rahul Gandhi**, the Congress leader, was accused by Fadnavis of being a liar. The opposition parties countered that the government is trying to use the issue for political gain ahead of elections in West Bengal and Tamil Nadu.

recent_articles.title: It’ a red-letter day, says Revanth; KTR blames BJP - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Following the defeat of the Women's Reservation Bill in Parliament, **Congress** and **Bharatiya Rashtra Samithi (BRS)** leaders praised opposition parties for uniting to block the controversial legislation.  **Rahul Gandhi**, **Mallikarjun Kharge**, and **A. Revanth Reddy** led the charge against the bill, with **K. T. Rama Rao** blaming the BJP for its failure. **Bandi Sanjay** accused the Congress of using the bill to weaken southern India, while **N Ramchander Rao** criticized the bill's defeat as a setback for women's empowerment.

recent_articles.title: INDIA bloc opposes Delimitation Bill - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mallikarjun Kharge**, president of the **All India Congress Committee (AICC)**, announced that the INDIA bloc has unanimously decided to oppose the Delimitation Bill.  **Kharge** stated that opposition parties are not against the Women’s Reservation Bill but are concerned about the bill's linking with delimitation and seat increases in State Assemblies. Several Opposition leaders, including **T.R. Baalu**, **Tejashwi Yadav**, and **Sanjay Raut**, expressed their opposition to the Delimitation Bill.

recent_articles.title: CM Fadnavis to conduct probe in Chhagan Bhujbal’s helicopter landing in parking lot - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chhagan Bhujbal**, Maharashtra Food and Civil Supplies Minister, was aboard a helicopter that landed unexpectedly in Khanwadi village near Pune on Saturday. The incident occurred while the helicopter was traveling from Nashik to attend the 200th birth anniversary of Jyotiba Phule. **Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis** stated the incident would be investigated and confirmed it was a smooth landing with no issues.

recent_articles.title: Why did the Congress withdraw its candidate from Baramati at the last minute? - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **NCP** and **NCP(SP)** leaders, including Sunetra Pawar, met with **Maharashtra Congress** president Harshawardhan Sapkal to request the withdrawal of their candidate from the Baramati by-election.  The Pawars argued for a united front against a competing candidate, while **Congress** leaders expressed disappointment over the lack of outreach from the **NCP**. The **Congress** eventually backed down and agreed to withdraw its candidate in response to pressure from allies and the **Pawar family**.

recent_articles.title: Title ‘Swatantryaveer’ not conferred by government on Savarkar, grandnephew tells court - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Satyaki Savarkar**, the grandnephew of Vinayak Savarkar, testified in a defamation case against **Rahul Gandhi** before a special MP/MLA court in Pune. He stated that the title "Swatantryaveer" was not granted by any government and was given by writer **Sadashiv Ranade** in his biography.  He also confirmed that **Savarkar** studied in London during British rule, wrote several books under different names to avoid attention from authorities, and some of these works are available in libraries and archives. The cross-examination continues on April 13th.

recent_articles.title: Kerala Assembly election 2026 LIVE updates: Polling commences across the State; NCP (SP) leader A. K. Saseendran casts vote in Kannur - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Voting is underway in Kerala for the Assembly elections, with over 2.7 crore voters casting their ballots across 140 constituencies.  The ruling **LDF coalition** seeks a third term, while the **UDF** aims to regain power after a strong performance in local body elections. The **NDA**, bolstered by its Lok Sabha election and municipal corporation successes, is also vying for a foothold in the state.

recent_articles.title: Assembly elections 2026 LIVE updates: Voting begins in a single phase today in Assam, Kerala and Puducherry - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kerala**, **Assam**, and **Puducherry** held single-phase elections on April 9, 2026, with voting concluding at 5 p.m.  The results will be announced on May 4. The high-stakes elections in **Assam** are expected to see the BJP vying for a third consecutive term. In **Kerala**, three fronts – the CPI(M)-led LDF, the Congress-led UDF and the BJP-led NDA – are contesting across 140 constituencies.  The bypolls also took place in several states including Gujarat, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Nagaland and Tripura.

recent_articles.title: Battleground Baramati: Ajit Pawar’s son faces criticism over ‘immature’ comments against Congress - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Parth Pawar**, son of **Sunetra Pawar** and late **Ajit Pawar**, has faced criticism from the **Congress** for his comments against the party. The **Congress** accused him of being ungrateful, a bad orator, and politically convenient.  The party also reminded him that the Karnataka government had registered an FIR in his father's death investigation. **Sharad Pawar**, his grandfather, and other family members have taken a contradictory stance, while allies of the **Congress** urged for an unopposed election in Baramati.

recent_articles.title: Battle for Baramati: Sunetra Pawar files nomination, Sharad Pawar’s photo displayed during NCP rally - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sunetra Pawar**, daughter of **Sharad Pawar**, filed her nomination as the Nationalist Congress Party candidate for the upcoming Baramati by-election.  She was accompanied by Deputy Chief Minister **Eknath Shinde** and BJP cabinet minister **Chandrashekhar Bawankule**. **Sharad Pawar** expressed disapproval of his photo being displayed alongside **Narendra Modi** and **Amit Shah**, stating that it was wrong to do so. While senior NCP leaders, **Praful Patel** and **Sunil Tatkare**, suggested speaking with the Congress leadership for an unopposed election, Sunetra Pawar's son, **Parth**, indicated he would not engage in such negotiations.  **Sanjay Raut** of Shiv Sena UBT expressed that it was acceptable to field a candidate in elections.

recent_articles.title: Nepal and Bangladesh Gen Z election: Why one protest movement succeeded
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Umama Fatema**, a Bangladeshi activist, was disheartened by the lack of political power for Bangladesh's Gen Z protesters following their 2024 demonstrations. In contrast, Nepal saw its youth successfully gain political power with the **Rastriya Swatantra Party (RSP)** winning a landslide victory in a historic election. The success in Nepal is attributed to factors like resonating with citizens, consistent messaging, and an electoral system that favors coalition governments.  However, Bangladesh's Gen Z movement faced challenges due to the dominance of established parties, such as the **Awami League**, which benefited from anti-establishment sentiment. Despite the lack of immediate success, Bangladeshi youth activists remain hopeful for future change and are planning to continue their fight for reform.

recent_articles.title: Amit Jogi sentenced to life imprisonment in Jaggi murder case from 2003 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Chhattisgarh High Court** sentenced Amit Jogi, son of former Chief Minister Ajit Jogi, to life imprisonment for the 2003 murder of businessman-politician Ramavatar Jaggi. The court overturned a previous acquittal, stating that evidence clearly showed Amit Jogi as the mastermind behind the conspiracy and holding the trial court's decision as illegal.  Amit Jogi has appealed the verdict to the **Supreme Court**.

recent_articles.title: New Rajya Sabha members take oath - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sharad Pawar**, **Ramdas Athawale**, and 17 other new members were sworn in as Rajya Sabha members on Monday, April 6, 2026. The ceremony took place in the Rajya Sabha chamber with **C.P. Radhakrishnan** presiding.  The newly elected members represented various states including Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, West Bengal, and Odisha.

recent_articles.title: Akash Vishwanath More of Congress to contest Baramati Bypoll - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** has selected **Advocate Akash Vishwanath More** as its candidate for the Baramati assembly by-election. The party's decision was made after the seat became vacant following the death of incumbent MLA and Deputy Chief Minister, **Ajit Pawar**.  **Sunetra Pawar**, wife of **Ajit Pawar**, will be filing her nomination from the Mahayuti.

recent_articles.title: MVA rift: Uddhav likely to back Sunetra Pawar in Baramati bypoll, but Congress not on board - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Congress** broke with its MVA partners, declaring it would contest the upcoming Baramati Assembly by-election.  **Sunetra Pawar**, widow of deceased NCP leader **Ajit Pawar**, is the ruling alliance's candidate. **Shiv Sena (UBT)** chief **Uddhav Thackeray** is expected to announce his party's decision soon, with sources indicating a likely support for **Sunetra Pawar**.  The Congress, however, has decided to contest the by-election independently, citing a lack of communication and participation in alliance discussions.

recent_articles.title: Sunetra Pawar to file nomination on April 6, contest won’t be unopposed in Baramati - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sunetra Pawar**, the Deputy Chief Minister of Maharashtra, will file her nomination for the Baramati by-election on April 6th. The seat fell vacant after the death of her husband **Ajit Pawar** in an air crash earlier this year.  The election is expected to test the unity of the opposition Maha Vikas Aghadi alliance as allies may compete against each other. While the Nationalist Congress Party (NCP) has declared it will not field a candidate against Sunetra Pawar, the Maharashtra Congress and Shiv Sena UBT have expressed their intention to support a candidate in Baramati.

recent_articles.title: ‘On Kharat’s call list, DCM Eknath Shinde, Minister Shirsat, Uddhav’s close aide Milind Narvekar’ - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Anjali Damania**, a social activist, claims that **Eknath Shinde**, **Sanjay Shirsat**, **Milind Narvekar**, and other prominent politicians were on the call list of arrested godman **Ashok Kharat**.  Damania based her claim on a CDR she possesses, stating that there were 17 calls between **Shinde** and **Kharat**, with one call lasting for 21 minutes. **Rupali Chakankar**, an NCP leader, had the most frequent conversations with **Kharat**, followed by his sister and other high-profile individuals like **Sunil Tatkare**, **Chandrakant Patil**, and **Ashish Shelar**.

recent_articles.title: Shiv Sena (UBT) open to alliance with MNS for Maharashtra’s benefit, says Sanjay Raut - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sharad Pawar**, NCP (SP) chief, and six other candidates from the **Mahayuti alliance** filed nominations for seven Rajya Sabha seats in Maharashtra.  The ruling coalition's nominees are expected to be elected unopposed due to a lack of opposition. **Sanjay Raut**, Shiv Sena (UBT) leader, stated his party is willing to make concessions for the benefit of Maharashtra and its Marathi-speaking population.

recent_articles.title: Kerala Assembly polls 2026 | There was no young candidate on NCP’s final list to challenge my candidature in Elathur: A.K. Saseendran - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The LDF candidate** for the Elathur Assembly constituency, despite protests from some within the **Nationalist Congress Party**, decided to contest after the party finalized his name for a winnable seat.  A farmer's candidate has emerged in the urban constituency, citing concerns of upland farmers. The candidate believes that the government has taken sufficient measures to prevent human-wildlife conflict and that climate change must be considered when addressing it.  The LDF government has implemented several initiatives such as the appointment of tribal youths as Beat Forest Officers and revised compensation for families of those killed in wildlife attacks, but the candidate also criticizes rival parties for declining commitment to democratic principles.

recent_articles.title: BJP fields Harshad Parmar for Umreth bypoll in Gujarat - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** announced **Harshad Parmar**, son of former MLA Govind Parmar, as its candidate for the upcoming byelection in Gujarat's Umreth Assembly constituency. The party confirmed Mr. Parmar's candidacy following his father's death on March 6th.  The Election Commission of India has scheduled polling for April 23rd. Other parties, including the Congress, have yet to announce their nominees.

recent_articles.title: Kerala Assembly elections: Full list of LDF candidates - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The Left Democratic Front (LDF) has released its complete list of candidates for the upcoming Kerala Legislative Assembly election. The CPI(M) fielded a strong lineup led by Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan, with prominent ministerial presence and several Independents supporting the LDF.  The CPI also renominated all four of its incumbent Ministers.
